title: cedar shavings in cotton bags
text: cedar shavings in cotton bags. When you first open the bag they are delightful... aromatic...  They note that when the fragrance lessens, just crush/press the bags.  Hmm. Ok.  But it's within about 3 days that you need to do that and it is never the strength of the first time.  They do faintly smell of freshly shaved cedar. Very nice. But it doesn't last long enough in my mind.  Put all 12 of them in my two door (sliding) closet... very small area... The bags themselves are small.. about 3" long.. thin cotton like material.  The doors of my closet are kept closed.  At first you could catch a whiff when you opened the doors... now, nothing.  I will continue to "crush" the bags for a few more weeks and then probably toss them.  You could try some essential oil drops or spray to possibly lengthen their strength.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  Overall, I would not recommend these for anything more than very temporary, brief use or possibly in an enclosed plastic tub?
